scientificTheAlmanac.name: The Almanac
scientificTheAlmanac.flavor: A year is a book; we learned to read ahead.
scientificTheAlmanac.text: Libraries cost 25% less production and give +1 production.

scientificTheScribesHall.name: The Scribes' Hall
scientificTheScribesHall.flavor: Every hand that can write is a hand that can teach.
scientificTheScribesHall.text: Cities with a Library gain +1 science per four citizens and +1 culture per three citizens.

theCelestialRites.name: The Celestial Rites
theCelestialRites.flavor: The sky keeps its own calendar, and we copied it.
deferred: your capital gathers faith from the sky, and being the first to set eyes on each new kind of country or ground pays faith besides

fieldNotebooks.name: Field Notebooks
fieldNotebooks.flavor: Nothing is found twice unless it is written down.
fieldNotebooks.text: Claiming a ruin grants 15 science, 20 culture and 20 gold.

naturalPhilosophy.name: Natural Philosophy
naturalPhilosophy.flavor: Name the world and it begins to answer.
deferred: being the first to set eyes on each new kind of country or ground pays science, and feeds your capital

apprenticeEngineers.name: Apprentice Engineers
apprenticeEngineers.flavor: First the book, then the shovel, then the road.
deferred: towns with a library raise workers faster, and the first works of each kind you build on ground of your own pay the town that holds them

theLongStudy.name: The Long Study
theLongStudy.flavor: A roof, a lamp, and a long patience.
deferred: a library that has stood a long while pays culture and renown, and pays more again once it is very old

theResearchAnnals.name: The Research Annals
theResearchAnnals.flavor: Knowledge kept is knowledge that keeps.
deferred: while this sits in council, your capital works and sings for every technology you have completed, up to a limit

practicalAstronomy.name: Practical Astronomy
practicalAstronomy.flavor: The same stars that steer a ship will feed a town.
practicalAstronomy.text: Scouts and ships gain +1 sight. Coastal cities with a Library gain +3 food.

patientResearch.name: Patient Research
deferred: science buildings cost more to raise, and each one that has stood a long while feeds and works the town it stands in

theGlassmakersCharter.name: The Glassmakers' Charter
theGlassmakersCharter.flavor: Sand, fire, and a second look at everything.
deferred: drafting this opens the study of lenses for research

theOpenCollegium.name: The Open Collegium
theOpenCollegium.flavor: The chair stays empty until the right mind sits in it.
deferred: you gain more renown while no great person of yours is waiting to be spent

workingEstates.name: Working Estates
workingEstates.flavor: A great mind leaves a field behind it.
workingEstates.text: Worked great-person improvements gain +3 food and +2 gold.

theOldAcademy.name: The Old Academy
theOldAcademy.flavor: Ivy is the proof of teaching.
deferred: an academy that has stood a long while feeds and works the town it serves, and more again once it is very old

learnedCommissions.name: Learned Commissions
learnedCommissions.flavor: Commission the hall before you commission the statue.
deferred: towns with a library work faster on empire buildings, and completing each kind of them for the first time pays culture and faith

scientificTheAssay.name: The Assay
scientificTheAssay.flavor: Weigh it, burn it, then believe it.
deferred: you gain science and gold for each different kind of strategic deposit you can draw on

theStrategicReserves.name: The Strategic Reserves
theStrategicReserves.flavor: The second seam is the one that makes a trade.
deferred: every improved strategic deposit past the first of its kind works and pays the town that holds it, and a great person's works count as improvements here

thePracticalArts.name: The Practical Arts
thePracticalArts.flavor: Study what you are already doing, and do it better.
deferred: technologies that match what your empire already does cost less to research, while ordinary soldiers cost more to raise

researchThroughConstruction.name: Research through Construction
researchThroughConstruction.flavor: We learned the arch by raising it.
deferred: your towns' science becomes production instead, and finishing an ordinary building pays research worth part of its price

theEndowedProvinces.name: The Endowed Provinces
theEndowedProvinces.flavor: A gift of learning keeps giving grain.
deferred: each town working a great person's work is fed and worked the better for it, once per town

theMetallurgistsCharter.name: The Metallurgists' Charter
deferred: drafting this opens the study of alloys for research

theNaturalistsCharter.name: The Naturalists' Charter
theNaturalistsCharter.flavor: Give the beast a name and the field a page.
deferred: drafting this opens the study of living things for research

theRoyalSociety.name: The Royal Society
theRoyalSociety.flavor: Letters after a name, and lamps in every window.
deferred: each empire building pays renown, and gladdens the town that holds it, once per town

theLearnedChancery.name: The Learned Chancery
theLearnedChancery.flavor: The clerk with a book governs further than the clerk with a seal.
deferred: a town holding an empire building costs less authority to keep and pushes its borders out faster

theAcademyQuarter.name: The Academy Quarter
theAcademyQuarter.flavor: Put the schools on one street and listen.
deferred: a town holding an empire building works and earns for each different kind of great person's work it works, up to a limit, and a second empire building adds nothing

theInheritedSchool.name: The Inherited School
theInheritedSchool.flavor: The teacher dies; the lesson keeps its chair.
deferred: worked academies and manufactories feed and work the better for each different family of great person whose legacy you still keep, up to a limit

discoveriesThroughGreatPeople.name: Discoveries through Great People
discoveriesThroughGreatPeople.flavor: A life spent well is a chapter finished early.
deferred: spending a great person on an act, a work or a legacy pays part of the research you are studying, at most once in a turn

husbandryStudies.name: Husbandry Studies
husbandryStudies.flavor: Study the horse and the horse goes further.
deferred: soldiers of yours that depend on horses are quicker on their feet from the day they are raised, and stay so

enduringInstitutions.name: Enduring Institutions
enduringInstitutions.flavor: What is old enough to be trusted is old enough to be useful.
deferred: a town whose empire building has stood a long while is gladder and builds faster, once per town

thePatentRolls.name: The Patent Rolls
thePatentRolls.flavor: First is a fact, and facts are worth recording.
deferred: completing a technology before any other empire pays culture and renown

commissionsOfService.name: Commissions of Service
commissionsOfService.flavor: Send the great where the need is, not where the marble is.
deferred: spending a great person on an act or a legacy pays food and gold to your nearest town, though placing a work does not

theQuietFaculties.name: The Quiet Faculties
theQuietFaculties.flavor: Quiet halls, full barns, and very few drums.
deferred: towns working a great person's work grow and build faster, but raise soldiers more slowly

theMechanistsCharter.name: The Mechanists' Charter
deferred: drafting this opens the study of mechanics for research

theAlchemistsCharter.name: The Alchemists' Charter
theAlchemistsCharter.flavor: Turn one thing into another and call it a trade.
deferred: drafting this opens the study of chemistry for research

theSecondSeat.name: The Second Seat
theSecondSeat.flavor: One of a kind is a habit, not a law.
deferred: you may raise one further copy of an empire building, in a town that holds a university, and only one such copy may be building or standing at a time

theLongInheritance.name: The Long Inheritance
theLongInheritance.flavor: Old works build the new ones.
deferred: towns working a great person's work that has stood a long while build empire buildings, wonders and the great work faster, and faster again where the empire building there is itself old

masterArtificers.name: Master Artificers
masterArtificers.flavor: The hands that made the tools now make everything else.
masterArtificers.text: Worked Academies and Manufactories gain +6 production and +6 gold.

theDistantColleges.name: The Distant Colleges
theDistantColleges.flavor: Learning travels further than a cart.
deferred: a town holding an empire building may work your great people's works one hex beyond its usual reach, and gains no ground and no citizens by it

theSocietyOfArtificers.name: The Society of Artificers
theSocietyOfArtificers.flavor: Bread and song out of a workshop.
deferred: a town holding an empire building that works an academy or a manufactory is fed and sung to in proportion to what it builds

theLearnedRealm.name: The Learned Realm
theLearnedRealm.flavor: A realm that reads is a realm that holds together.
deferred: each town working a great person's work widens your authority, up to a limit, and towns with a library that has stood a long while are gladder
